edges.subject: recombinant human proenzyme of tripeptidyl-peptidase 1
edges.quote: Recently, the FDA approved the use of recombinant human proenzyme of tripeptidyl-peptidase 1 for CLN2 disease, while phase I/IIa clinical trials for gene therapy in CLN3 and CLN6 are ongoing.
